Error indicating a syntax error in configuration or template files.

## Signature

```typescript
export declare class JsonSyntaxError extends Error
```
**Extends:** Error

## Remarks

This error is thrown when parsing JSON files. This typically occurs during the parsing phase before semantic validation. Use this error when the structure of the input is malformed, as opposed to [InputError](/xpm-lib-ts/docs/api/xpm-lib/classes/inputerror) or [ConfigurationError](/xpm-lib-ts/docs/api/xpm-lib/classes/configurationerror) which indicate semantically invalid but syntactically correct input.
